name: Aldo
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30057.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Amidol: Heading out for an adventure, eh? Are you really planning on taking all that stuff? Let me give you some advice, kid. Don't weigh yourself down with all sorts of unnecessary equipment. Just take what you need. Leave the rest with me. The Iron Gate Guild will keep your items…

warehouse/30057-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Amidol: I teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers, and Bounty Hunters. If you are an Artisan or Warsmith, go to a Blacksmith.

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30057-01.ht.text: Warehouse Freightman Aldo: Well, a while back he mentioned he didn't have anything to wear to an event... Maybe he would like a new outfit! By the way, how do you know Barbado?

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30057-02.ht.text: Warehouse Freightman Aldo: Well, Barbado has a fondness for music... He is quite an accordionist... He once mentioned that he wanted to learn another instrument... I believe it was the flute... By the way, who are you? How do you know Barbado?

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30057-03.ht.text: Warehouse Freightman Aldo: Ah, Barbado... Yes, he does enjoy a nice cold black beer after he finishes playing his music... By the way, who are you? What is your relationship to Barbado?

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30057-04.ht.text: Warehouse Freightman Aldo: I am Aldo. What is your name?
